Not a full re-run of every check against the whole document -- everything else (S1-S6, S8-S11, including the FOR UPDATE concurrency mechanism, qr_token generation, and the S8/AC7 audit-row reading) was already independently re-derived and confirmed correct in my prior pass and is untouched by this rework.

2. S7.3 (current lines 432-437) likewise has no code fence -- the `InlineKeyboard` construction is now prose ('an `InlineKeyboard` with exactly one button, whose label is sourced from `catalog.registration.registerButton` and whose callback_data is composed as the literal prefix `register:` followed by the event's id'), no object-construction expression, no template-literal interpolation. Confirmed via `grep -n '```' docs/agents/design/REQ-020.md`: fence markers exist only at lines 157/178, 205/210, 224/231, 282/284, 328/330, 347/349, 455/473 -- none in the 380-448 range that contains S7.1/S7.3. Every one of those surviving fences is unchanged from the version I already passed (interface/type declarations in S2.1, a first-match-wins table not a fence in S2.2, bare function signatures in S2.3/S3.1) -- signatures and types only, no executable bodies, and none of them fall inside this diff's changed lines.

3. Semantic equivalence check (the diff must not have silently changed the rule while removing the code): S7.1's prose states the same pattern -- literal prefix `register:` followed by the captured event id -- as the removed regex `/^register:(.+)$/`, still anchored to the same `CHAPTER_CALLBACK_PATTERN` convention in `handlers/start.ts`, still re-matched against `ctx.callbackQuery?.data ?? ""` to recover `eventId`, still calling `answerCallbackQuery()` on every path -- all of this carried over verbatim from the pre-rework prose, only the removed code fence's content was moved into words. S7.3's prose states the same composition as the removed `new InlineKeyboard().text(catalog.registration.registerButton, \`register:${event.id}\`)` expression: exactly one button, label from `catalog.registration.registerButton`, callback_data equal to the literal prefix `register:` plus the event's id, explicitly cross-referenced back to '§7.1's pattern' to keep the two sections' shape consistent with each other. No format drift (e.g. no switch to a different separator or a different catalog key) between the removed code and the new prose in either spot.

No re-verification needed since they were not touched and are not implicated in the sole finding this rework addressed.

5. No new finding introduced by this rework: the diff is a pure code-to-prose rewrite with no other content change (no new claim, no new token reference, no new open question, no scope change to any acceptance criterion).

The single MAJOR finding from my prior FAIL is closed. No other issue found.
